    - heading "Meet Amazon Cognito" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Amazon Cognito helps you implement secure sign-in and access control for users, AI agents, and microservices in minutes. Processing more than 100 billion authentications per month, Cognito provides comprehensive identity and access management for both human users and machine identities. It is a cost-effective service that provides tenant-based identity stores and federation options. Cognito helps you create branded customer experiences, improve security, and adapt to your customers’ needs. For example, it supports login with social identity providers and passwordless login using WebAuthn passkeys or SMS and email one-time-passwords. Additionally, Cognito is tightly integrated with
